Title: Nitin's Day

Cast

1. Nitin - 30 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Sunita - 57 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Sanjay - 30 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Nitin stands on the battlefield. Sanjay stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[An arrow strikes Nitin in the chest and he clutches the wound.]

Nitin (gently): "That's easy."

[A sword slashes Nitin's arm and blood runs down to his wrist.]

Nitin: "Okay, Sanjay."

[Wounded, Nitin staggers and drops to one knee.]

Nitin (surprised): "Sanjay, are you okay?"

[Nitin is hit in the leg and limps away bleeding.]

Nitin: "What a day to remember!"
